title: Investigation of Zn-, Pb-, and Cd-containing nanoparticles in Canadian urban and Arctic environments: a comprehensive study utilizing single particle inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry for characterization
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00258C, Paper
Open Access

Richard Macedo de Oliveira, Dorthe Dahl-Jensen, Feiyue Wang
SP-ICP-MS is a valuable technique for characterizing zinc, lead, and cadmium-containing nanoparticles released from anthropogenic activities and transported to both urban and remote areas, including the High Arctic.
